_comment: Mock Kalshi-style daily-high-temperature markets for 2026-06-03. Prices in dollars (0-1). no_bid/no_ask are the complementary NO book (no_bid = 1 - yes_ask). Seeded to exercise every signal path against data/mock_weather.json.

markets.title: Will the high temp in NYC be >80° on Jun 3, 2026?
markets.rules: Settles YES if the NWS Daily Climate Report high temperature for NYC (Central Park / KNYC) is greater than 80 F.
markets.settlement_source: NWS Daily Climate Report - NYC Central Park (KNYC)
